name: git
summary: Inspect and change one local Git repository (official MCP reference server, local stdio)

repo.prompt: A path inside the one Git working tree this server may use

notes: You are granting access to the repository containing the path you give: its full history and working tree can be read, and changed through the tools that stage, commit, reset, branch and check out.
The server walks up from the path to the repository root at startup. The README calls it early development, so tool names and behaviour may change.
There is no read tool that works without arguments (each takes repo_path), so no smoke test is configured.
Runs on your machine via uvx and needs uv. The version is pinned; update it deliberately.
